content.short: Flowscan is a real-time explorer and analytics view for Hyperliquid activity.
content.description: Flowscan presents Hyperliquid activity as it happens, sitting between a conventional block explorer and an analytics dashboard. It is used less for looking up a single transaction hash and more for watching flow across the network as positions build and unwind. Because it reads HyperCore trading activity rather than only EVM transactions, it covers the half of the chain that a standard explorer cannot see.
content.meta: Flowscan is a real-time Hyperliquid explorer combining block data with order book analytics.
